Description.SourceString: 回到伊波恩二楼
Description.LocalizedString: Return to the Second Floor of Eibon

PanelDescription.SourceString: 回到伊波恩二楼，看看到底出了什么事。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Return to the Second Floor of Eibon to see what's happening.

Description.SourceString: 消磨时间到第二天早上8时
Description.LocalizedString: Pass time until 8 AM the next day

PanelDescription.SourceString: 今天似乎没有什么特别的事情，随便打发打发时间吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Doesn't seem like anything special is happening today. Might as well kill some time.

Description.SourceString: 前往伊波恩大厅
Description.LocalizedString: Go to Eibon Lobby

PanelDescription.SourceString: 又到了伊波恩的营业时间，今天是否会有生意上门呢？去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's Eibon's opening hours again. I wonder if we'll have any customers today? Let's go see.

Description.SourceString: 不知新的一天是否会有生意上门，先与阿德勒先生聊聊
Description.LocalizedString: I wonder if we'll have any customers today. Let's chat with Mr. Adler for now

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉与塔吉多的矛盾似乎只能静待契机由他们主动化解。新的一天，去看看有没有生意上门吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems the conflict between Nanally and Taygedo can only be resolved when they're ready to take that step themselves. It's a new day—let's see if any customers come by.

Description.SourceString: 出发前往异象管理局，解决塔吉多的市民证问题
Description.LocalizedString: Head to the Bureau of Anomaly Control to resolve Taygedo's Ctizen ID issue

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不出意外要在异象管理局为塔吉多的市民证忙上一天，不过塔吉多看起来颇为能干的样子，放心交给他应该没问题吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like we'll be spending the whole day at the Bureau of Anomaly Control sorting out Taygedo's Citizen ID, unless something unexpected happens. But Taygedo seems quite capable—should be fine to leave it to him, right?

Description.SourceString: 塔吉多似乎在打量着什么……
Description.LocalizedString: Taygedo seems to be sizing something up…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多好久没来异管局了，不知道现在办理市民证应该去哪里）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo hasn't been to BAC in so long, I wonder where is the Citizen ID counter.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我们找人问一下吧，那边好像就有工作人员在修理机器。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's find someone to ask. It looks like there's staff over there fixing some machinery.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小短腿跑得还挺快
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Those short legs can really move!

Description.SourceString: 前往袋先生的收发室，换领新的市民证
Description.LocalizedString: Go to Mr. Bag's Mailroom to collect the new Citizen ID

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与塔吉多的新朋友布洛凯德闲聊了几句后，塔吉多总算想起来他的市民证问题。袋先生的收发室就在这附近，赶紧去那边吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After chatting with his new friend Barracuda for a bit, Taygedo finally remembered his Citizen ID issue. Mr. Bag's Mailroom is nearby—we should head there right away.

Description.SourceString: 与塔吉多一起前往安全评估室准备接受测评
Description.LocalizedString: Head to the Safety Assessment Room with Taygedo for his evaluation test

PanelDescription.SourceString: 简单了解关于市民证的小知识后，我们准备前往安全评估室等待接受测评。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After getting a brief overview about Citizen ID, we're now heading to the Safety Assessment Room to wait for our evaluation.

Description.SourceString: 安全评估室前排起了队，稍微等待一会儿
Description.LocalizedString: There's a line forming in front of the Safety Assessment Room. We'll have to wait a bit

PanelDescription.SourceString: 安全评估室正在使用中，看来前来办理市民证业务的异象还不少。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Safety Assessment Room is currently in use. Looks like there are quite a few Anomalies here to process their Citizen ID applications.

Description.SourceString: 布洛凯德与塔吉多似乎有聊不完的话题……
Description.LocalizedString: Barracuda and Taygedo seem to have endless topics to talk about…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 布洛凯德忙完工作，也在安全评估室排队等候。塔吉多和他似乎有聊不完的话题。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After finishing his work, Barracuda is also waiting in line at the Safety Assessment Room. He and Taygedo seem to have endless topics to discuss.

Description.SourceString: 等待塔吉多完成测评。
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for Taygedo to complete his evaluation

PanelDescription.SourceString: 热情大方的布洛凯德邀请塔吉多先接受测评，塔吉多也完全不打算和新朋友客气客气。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The enthusiastic and generous Barracuda offers to let Taygedo take the evaluation first, and Taygedo doesn't hesitate for a second to accept his new friend's kindness.

Description.SourceString: 自来熟的布洛凯德从来不缺话题！天南海北畅聊中
Description.LocalizedString: The ever-sociable Barracuda never runs out of things to say! They're deep in conversation about everything under the sun

PanelDescription.SourceString: 布洛凯德打开了话匣子，一箩筐话题放送中。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Barracuda has unleashed a flood of conversation topics.

Description.SourceString: 塔吉多的测评非常顺利
Description.LocalizedString: Taygedo's evaluation goes extremely well

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看起来，塔吉多的测评一切顺利？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo's evaluation went smoothly?

Description.SourceString: 塔吉多正在盘算什么呢？
Description.LocalizedString: What is Taygedo plotting?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 嘀嘀咕咕的塔吉多不知道在盘算什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What could Taygedo be muttering and scheming about?

Description.SourceString: 等待布洛凯德结束测评
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for Barracuda to complete his evaluation

PanelDescription.SourceString: 决定和塔吉多一起等待布洛凯德，等他出来后问问他有关异象管理局的详细情报。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I decide to wait with Taygedo for Barracuda to come out, so I can ask him for more detailed intel about the Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Description.SourceString: 接受布洛凯德的邀请，参加异象们的咖啡会
Description.LocalizedString: Accept Barracuda's invitation to the Anomalies' coffee time

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知道异象管理局的咖啡会是什么样子？跟着布洛凯德一起去瞧瞧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Curious about what the Bureau of Anomaly Control's coffee is like? Let's follow Barracuda and check it out!

Description.SourceString: 先找袋先生取回塔吉多的市民证
Description.LocalizedString: First find Mr. Bag to retrieve Taygedo's Citizen ID

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与塔吉多商量了一番，决定先去袋先生处取回市民证，再参加咖啡会。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After discussing with Taygedo, we decide to retrieve the Citizen ID from Mr. Bag first, then attend the coffee time.

Description.SourceString: 前往会议室，重要的是吃好喝好
Description.LocalizedString: Head to the meeting room—the priority is good food and drinks

PanelDescription.SourceString: 动身前往举办咖啡会的会议室，期待满满。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I head toward the Meeting Room where the coffee time is being held, filled with anticipation.

Description.SourceString: 塔吉多总算是收到了他的新市民证……
Description.LocalizedString: Taygedo has finally received his new Citizen ID…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 决定与娜娜莉道歉和好的塔吉多立刻动身冲向袋先生处，决定拿到市民证后要第一时间赶回伊波恩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Having decided to apologize and make amends with Nanally, Taygedo immediately rushes off to Mr. Bag's place, determined to get his Citizen ID and return to Eibon as quickly as possible.

Description.SourceString: 回到伊波恩，见证塔吉多与娜娜莉的和好
Description.LocalizedString: Return to Eibon to witness Taygedo and Nanally's reconciliation

PanelDescription.SourceString: 接下来就是赶快回到伊波恩，见证塔吉多与娜娜莉的和好。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now it's time to hurry back to Eibon and witness the reconciliation between Taygedo and Nanally.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>异象管理局</>申请「车票」
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Bureau of Anomaly Control</> to apply for a Train Ticket

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「咕咕」的鸣叫还在脑子里回响……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The sound of cooing is still echoing in my mind…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 要搭乘异象列车「幽灵号」，必须持有异象管理局颁发的乘车许可证——也就是所谓的「车票」。事不宜迟，现在就前往管理局办理申领手续吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To board the Anomaly Metro "Ghost Train," you must have a boarding permit issued by the Bureau of Anomaly Control—what's commonly called a "Train Ticket." There's no time to waste. Head to the Bureau right now to apply for one.

QuestName.LocalizedString: First Step to Getting a Train Ticket

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>袋先生</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Mr. Bag</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 生活安全处的袋先生负责乘车许可证的申请事宜。向他询问具体的办理流程吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mr. Bag from the Daily Safety Department is in charge of boarding permit applications. He should be able to help with the whole process.

Description.SourceString: 等待<blue>片刻</>课程安排通知
Description.LocalizedString: Wait <blue>a moment</> for the session invitation

PanelDescription.SourceString: 袋先生会将讲解课程安排妥当，现在只需等待通知就好。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mr. Bag is going to help you arrange the briefing session. Now to just wait for the invitation…

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>课程邀约</>
Description.LocalizedString: Check the <blue>course invitation</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 袋先生发来了讲解课程的相关通知，查阅一下具体安排吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mr. Bag sent a notification about the instruction course. I should check the specific arrangements.

Description.SourceString: 返回异象车站
Description.LocalizedString: Return to Anomaly Station

PanelDescription.SourceString: 返回异象车站
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Return to Anomaly Station

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>车站</>参与课程
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Station</> to join the session

PanelDescription.SourceString: 作为最了解幽灵号的列车管理员，浮游小姐确实是最合适的讲师。只是希望她的授课内容不要太过冗长……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As the Train Manager who knows the Ghost Train best, Miss Levi is the most suitable instructor indeed. Let's just hope her session won't go on for too long…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>异象管理局</>参加笔试
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Bureau of Anomaly Control</> to take the written exam

PanelDescription.SourceString: 现在是时候检验努力学习的成果了。前往异象管理局，接受袋先生的笔试考核吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now it's time to put all that hard studying to the test. Head to the Bureau of Anomaly Control and take Mr. Bag's written exam.

Description.SourceString: 等待实测安排通知<blue>第二天早晨10点</>
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for practical test arrangement notification <blue>10 AM the next morning</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 顺利通过笔试后，该进入实测环节了。先回去休息，等待浮游小姐的测试邀请吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Having successfully passed the written exam, it's time for the practical test phase. Go back and rest for now, and wait for Miss Levi's test invitation.

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>通知</>
Description.LocalizedString: Check the <blue>notification</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 浮游小姐已经做好了实测准备。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miss Levi has prepared for the practical test.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>车站</>参加实测
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>station</> to take the practical test

PanelDescription.SourceString: 通过这场实测考核，就能取得「车票」了。现在就前往考场——幽灵号的站台吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Pass this practical test and you'll earn your Train Ticket. Now, head to the exam venue—the Ghost Train platform.

Description.SourceString: 通过<blue>实测</>
Description.LocalizedString: Pass the <blue>practical test</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 登上幽灵号，发挥异象猎人的真本领吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Board the Ghost Train and show off what you're truly capable of as an Anomaly Hunter.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>浮游小姐</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Miss Levi</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 浮游小姐欣慰地迎接她的第一个学生。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miss Levi warmly welcomes her first student with a sense of pride and relief.

Description.SourceString: 等待至<blue>第二天早晨9点</>管理局颁发「车票」
Description.LocalizedString: Wait until <blue>9:00 AM the next day</> for the Bureau to issue a Train Ticket

PanelDescription.SourceString: 所有测试都已通过，只需等待管理局完成审核流程。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: All tests have been passed. Now I just need to wait for the Bureau to complete their review process.

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>通知</>
Description.LocalizedString: Check the <blue>notification</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 异象管理局衷心祝愿新乘客旅途愉快。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Bureau of Anomaly Control sincerely wishes the new passenger a pleasant journey.

QuestName.LocalizedString: New Passenger of the Ghost Train

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>车站</>领取「车票」
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>station</> to collect your Train Ticket

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这张「车票」将打开通往幽灵号和无数异象空间的大门。新的旅途，此刻才刚刚启程。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This Train Ticket will open the door to the Ghost Train and countless Anomalous Realms. A new journey is just beginning.
